rule: Every new RoamSonio development version must be added here before it can become a production checkpoint. A version marked ISSUE or FAILED must never be used as a rollback target.

statuses.SUCCESS: User-tested and approved as working; eligible for rollback.
statuses.TESTING: Deployed or in progress but not yet user-approved; not eligible for rollback.
statuses.ISSUE: User reported a problem; never use as a rollback target.
statuses.FAILED: Deployment or validation failed; never use as a rollback target.
